paragraphsHtml: In Professor Sotiris Nousias’s group, developed a Python and NumPy simulation of single-photon detection with a browser interface. The model includes photon arrivals, detection efficiency, dark counts, dead time, timing jitter, and picosecond timestamp quantization.
Applied Fourier analysis to the simulated timestamps. Numerical tests check photon statistics and spectral peaks under sparse signals, aliasing, detector saturation, and pulse trains.
Worked on an eight-person engineering and design team to develop and release a React Native telehealth app on iOS and Android. The app served 900+ users, with a 34% increase in appointment rebooking.

Integrated Amazon Chime for video sessions between licensed peer counselors and patients, supporting the platform’s HIPAA and SOC 2 requirements. Implemented booking through Cronofy with mutex locks to prevent concurrent requests from booking the same slot.
Led work on an Electron interface for SeisGo, a Python seismic-analysis package. Analysis time was 34% lower than with the lab’s Jupyter workflow.
Added Fourier-series analysis to SeisGo, which is distributed through PyPI.
Developed a search pipeline for 1,663 instructional clips from 250 videos. Compared TF-IDF, matching over action, object, tool, and supply fields, and hybrid ranking through blinded relevance tests.
Used OpenCV and PyTorch to classify home-inspection photos by repair category. The classifier reached 83% test accuracy on Kaggle data.
Changed a video-generation API workflow to use 16% fewer tokens while retaining output quality and reducing inference costs.

role: Research Intern · Perelman School of Medicine
paragraphsHtml: Analyzed 500,000+ emergency-room cases across 20 years of records in Professor Chamith Rajapakse’s lab. Trained a PyTorch/Keras network to estimate bone-fracture risk from environmental and movement features.

details.bodyHtml: Developed an Arduino/C++ device to measure mobility for physical-therapy assessment. Co-authored a poster accepted for presentation at the 2025 New England ACSM conference.
